title: Watercolor "Western Lake Luxe" 1383 Western Lake Drive
h1: Watercolor "Western Lake Luxe" 1383 Western Lake Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 12 wristbands.- Located in the Camp District of WaterColor- 4 Bedrooms plus bunk room- Access to community pools, nature trails, and dune lakes- Conveniently located near Publix & restaurants- 6 passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Professionally decorated- Open living area - 5 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: This newly renovated 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home at 1383 Western Lake Drive in WaterColor’s peaceful Camp district sleeps 12 and is steps away from Camp WaterColor's popular lazy river, pools, and waterslides. Guests will love the included 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle and the luxurious professional interior that feels like a home away from home. A lovely front porch with a classic porch swing welcomes guests to the home. Inside, a spacious open-concept kitchen, living, and dining room enjoys lots of natural light and is a wonderful space to relax with loved ones. Beautiful dark wood floors showcase a sophisticated living area with a flat-screen TV, fireplace, sofa, and armchairs. White shiplap walls visually connect the living area to the kitchen, which has premium appliances and gleaming white quartz countertops and a conveniently located half bathroom just off of the kitchen and dining area. Tucked behind the kitchen is a primary bedroom with an upholstered king bed and a private bathroom with a shower. An eat-in kitchen island seats 4 and is a casual spot for guests to enjoy breakfast or lunch. An adjacent dining table seats 8, or guests can step out onto a side screened porch and eat al fresco at an outdoor dining table. On the second floor are a second primary bedroom and 3 guest bedrooms. The primary bedroom has a king bed and 2 doors that open onto a porch. The private bathroom includes a new soaking tub and a separate shower. A sitting area outside of a bunk bedroom is a lovely spot for guests to gather before bed, watch a movie, or relax. A porthole window in the bunk room's door provides a bit of whimsy to this room with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds. The bunk room shares a bathroom with a shower/tub combo with a guest bedroom with a queen bed. A third guest bedroom has a king bed with a private bathroom with shower and doors that open onto another screened porch.Guests will enjoy exploring all of WaterColor's nearby community pools, parks, nature trails and the fabulous Camp WaterColor on 5 included adult bikes. Stocking groceries and going to dinner is easy on the included 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle. Guests also have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. WaterColor is an amenity-rich community that books quickly.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 12):First Floor:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySecond Floor:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 60 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home, and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.*The fireplace is not for guest use.
